NuBerea/ontology
	

The estate's prod-config knowledge graph plus its canonical textual-address layer: a knowledge
graph over the estate's own datasets/tools/routes, a deterministic verse/token/pericope address
resolver, and a set of query-time registries. Part of the NuBerea curated corpus estate of
biblical and historical texts. The full specification (per-config documentation, schemas,
methodology, and upstream provenance) is available in the gated SPEC accompanying this… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/NuBerea/ontology.
